# KCD2 Xbox 1.5.6 release profile

This directory contains the target-specific patched `defaultProfile.xml` used to build Clean Pause releases for KCD2 1.5.6 on PC Xbox Store / Xbox app / Game Pass.

The profile is stored as deterministic gzip+base64 text:

```text
defaultProfile.clean-pause.xml.gz.b64
```

It is versioned target source, not a generated installable artifact. GitHub Actions decodes/decompresses it and packages it into the mod PAK.

Verified original retail profile SHA-256:

```text
69ad9fd618cd31961fef8eb061f3f2723997df5e0fb257ec74d0d5f555592565
```

Current fail-safe patched profile SHA-256:

```text
9838db3747f7f36e0c9c281b8770bc7300998515407515b65493b8e9a9bcd14e
```

## Pause routing contract

The first prerelease, `v0.1.0-rc.1`, incorrectly used `consoleCmd="1"`. Retail testing showed that this consumed Esc/Start without running Clean Pause.

The corrected profile uses KCD2's exact `consoleCMD="1"` spelling and no longer replaces the vanilla pause route outright.

For each retail pause action:

```text
press   -> clean_pause_enter_*      (consoleCMD)
release -> original vanilla action  (open_menu / open_pause_menu)
```

If the custom press route succeeds, it immediately enables the exclusive `clean_pause_controls` map; that map contains `clean_pause_block_start_release`, so the same Esc/Start release cannot leak to vanilla.

If the custom command or Lua bootstrap fails, the controls map never activates and releasing Esc/Start still reaches the original vanilla pause action. A Clean Pause failure therefore degrades to the normal KCD2 pause instead of leaving the game with no pause control.

The exact Xbox Store 1.5.6 `no_menu` actionFail filter is also extended with the custom gameplay entry so Clean Pause cannot bypass contexts in which vanilla `open_menu` is forbidden.

The patched profile is generated by `tools/profile_patch.py`. Updating the supported game version requires regenerating this source from that version's exact retail profile, reviewing the result/structure, updating the expected digest in `tools/build_release.py`, and passing CI before publishing a new release.

Because KCD2 uses last-mod-wins for `defaultProfile.xml`, this release is intentionally version-specific and conflicts with other mods that replace the same file.
